blocks.text: Product Description               SunShield is a wood furniture polish that prevents outdoor furniture from cracking, drying, and fading due to harsh sun exposure, temperature changes, and moisture. Ideal as a wood polisher for furniture, its formula blends carnauba wax, beeswax, and orange oil with UV inhibitors to protect and enhance the natural beauty and grain of wood surfaces; it conditions and replenishes both finished and unfinished wood, making it great for use on teak and other tropical hardwoods. When your outdoor furniture begins to look faded or dry, SunShield acts as a beeswax for wood, deeply penetrating and restoring the natural oils of your cherished pieces. Use it regularly to maintain the appearance of chairs, tables, benches, chests, desks, and more.                  From the Manufacturer               Sunwax is specially designed to keep teak and other tropical hardwood furniture from cracking, drying and oxidizing due to exposure to sun, temperature variations or moisture. Sunwax combines UV inhibitors along with a unique blend of carnauba wax, beeswax and orange oil to protect the natural beauty and depth of grain in outdoor wood furniture. This distinctively blended product effectively penetrates and replenishes natural oils. Sunwax should be used regularly, or whenever outdoor furniture looks faded or dry.
